1.explanation:
The watermark should appear as part of the blocks workspace (where code blocks are edited). Since this functionality overlays UI elements in the blocks editing area, the core components likely to need changes are:

1. src/components/blocks/blocks.jsx: This is the main presentational component rendering the blocks workspace UI. The overlay image (watermark) should be rendered here so it appears above/below the blocks, with correct opacity, placement, and right-to-left adaptiveness.
2. src/containers/blocks.jsx: This container usually provides props and state, such as the selected sprite/backdrop and relevant asset info (thumbnail, costume). To support the watermark overlay, it must pass the current selection's image source and type to blocks.jsx, and/or handle any dynamic logic for RTL, sizing, etc.

Other files (like stage.jsx or sprite-selector) are not directly responsible for the blocks editing area UI itself, so changes are most relevant in the files above.
1.bug_scenario: The bug and feature request scenario concerns the absence of a watermark overlay showing the selected sprite or backdrop in the blocks workspace. The old (2.0) Scratch editor displayed a faded, semi-transparent image of the selected sprite or backdrop (max 48x48px) in the top right of the code area, helping clarify what is being edited. The report specifies size/positioning, opacity (approx. 35%), RTL support, and proper z-index. The scenario images demonstrate both the desired and missing watermark behaviors for sprites and backdrops.

2.explanation: To implement the watermark functionality, the main blocks workspace UI (src/components/blocks/blocks.jsx) must be modified to render the watermark according to which sprite or backdrop is currently selected. Since the watermark reflects the sprite/backdrop selection, the selection logic is managed by reducers (src/reducers/targets.js), and container components (src/containers/blocks.jsx, src/containers/sprite-info.jsx) pass this state down. The stage/header and selector components (src/components/stage-header/stage-header.jsx, src/components/sprite-selector/sprite-selector.jsx, src/components/stage-selector/stage-selector.jsx, src/containers/stage-header.jsx) may require minor updates to support RTL, expose the correct thumbnails/assets, or coordinate layout as the new watermark is added. src/lib/layout-constants.js is included since sizing and spacing constants should centrally update to ensure 48x48px and 20px margin are respected. Collectively, these files cover the logic and rendering of block workspace display, sprite selection, asset lookup, and consistent layout, all of which are impacted by adding the watermark.
2.bug_scenario: The bug/feature scenario described in the report requires displaying a watermark (a faded, right-aligned thumbnail of the currently selected sprite or backdrop) at the top-right of the blocks workspace. The watermark should be sized (48x48px max), right-aligned (beside zoom controls), have 35% opacity, adjust for RTL languages, and have correct z-index. The bug scenario images confirm the visual design: the watermark appears on the blocks workspace, indicating the current selection, and tracks which sprite or backdrop is selected as the user clicks around.
